blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines produced Southeast Asia’s biggest initial public offering (IPO) this year as GCash parent Mynt Inc. raised $956 million, lifting domestic IPO proceeds by about 60 percent even as fundraising fell across the region.
